from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = []
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0 = min(rr for rr,cc in cells)
            r1 = max(rr for rr,cc in cells)
            c0 = min(cc for rr,cc in cells)
            c1 = max(cc for rr,cc in cells)
            shape = {(rr-r0, cc-c0) for rr,cc in cells}
            objects.append((c0, r0, color, r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: (obj[0], obj[1]))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    prev_h = prev_w = 0
    for i, (_, _, color, oh, ow, shape) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            top += prev_h - 1
            left += prev_w - 1
        for rr, cc in shape:
            y, x = top + rr, left + cc
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
        prev_h, prev_w = oh, ow
    return out
'''
